Class BlendModeColorFilter

java.lang.Object
icyllis.modernui.graphics.ColorFilter
icyllis.modernui.graphics.BlendModeColorFilter
public final class BlendModeColorFilter extends ColorFilter
A color filter that can be used to tint the source pixels using a single color and a specific BlendMode.
Since:
